meta.title: A live technical round with no bid end must not crash the timing rule
gaps: The operation vocabulary does not define the complete working body for /trade/template_input, so only the stated changed fields are sent.
The expected HTTP 422 is expressible through the reject outcome, but no application error code for this case is provided.

words.preconditions: A fresh draft event with one line item and an RFQ (pricing) round attached, not published.
steps: The buyer sends the request that adds a round to the event, the request the case itself writes.
As the buyer, read the event and check that Status check: the reply's status code is a success (2xx — the request worked).
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with a clear message, and never with a server error. Read back afterwards: Status check: the reply's status code is a success (2xx — the request worked).
